events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: The iconic Rolling Stones frontman, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still strutting like no other! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Mick Jagger. What's your favourite Stones track?

events.title: MTV launched in the US
events.blurb: On this day in 1981, MTV launched in the United States with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' being the very first music video ever played.

angles.name: MTV's First Video
angles.copy: Remember a time before YouTube? Forty-five years ago today, MTV launched, and the first video they ever played was The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. Did video really kill the radio star? We think not!

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in the UK on this day in 1994, featuring classics like 'Supersonic' and 'Live Forever'.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. What's your top track from this iconic album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival began in 1969
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, kicked off on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in New York for '3 Days of Peace & Music'. The original Woodstock Festival began – what a lineup!

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 49 years since the world lost the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago, the music world lost an icon. Remembering the one and only Elvis Presley today. His legacy as the King of Rock and Roll lives on.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1970, the world tragically lost guitar virtuoso Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 83 this year.

angles.name: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we said goodbye to a true guitar legend. Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix today. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is one of the most famous in history, but what's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! The voice and force behind The Pretenders. What's your favourite track from her?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid's another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' single released in UK
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Single Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon released the 'Imagine' single in the UK. A song that continues to resonate with its powerful message of peace.

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple introduced the very first iPod, revolutionising how we carry and listen to music.

angles.name: iPod's Debut
angles.copy: Remember when you could fit '1,000 songs in your pocket'? Twenty-five years ago today, Apple unveiled the original iPod, changing music listening forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is officially James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since Dr. No first hit screens. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the visionary John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in the UK on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles released their sprawling, iconic 'White Album'. Which track from the double LP stands out most for you?
